items.summary: Maintain containment this cycle: delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, so do not admit new CRO prototypes or duplicate queue work. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the next revenue experiment after CTO releases a slot. Measure only registered affiliate clicks; baseline is 61 clicks for 2026-09-21, while orders, commission, ROI, and causal lift remain unknown.

Deferred product opportunity for post-capacity review: build a disposable fleet content-normalization prototype using microsoft/markitdown. Evidence: MIT license, 194 files, 22 purpose-keyword hits, and 8/8 bounded lab checks; no dependencies were installed and no production access occurred. Fleet use case: normalize approved editorial and document fixtures into consistent Markdown for SEO briefs and content QA. Risks: dependency and parser maintenance, malformed or adversarial documents, copyright/provenance handling, and no evidence yet of traffic or conversion lift. Smallest reversible prototype: process a fixed fixture set in an isolated workspace and compare heading, metadata, link, and provenance extraction accuracy against a manually reviewed sample. Metric: extraction accuracy and analyst minutes saved per fixture. Time-to-learn: one engineering cycle after capacity clears. Do not adopt, deploy, or add dependencies until CTO security and maintenance review is complete.
